api_contract.time_struct_from_in: struct ds3231_time drv; drv.seconds = in->second; drv.minutes = in->minute; drv.hours = in->hour; drv.day = in->weekday; drv.date = in->day; drv.month = in->month; drv.year = in->year - 2000;

test_stimuli.name: nominal_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: seconds=0x59=59, minutes=0x59=59, hours=0x23=23, day=0x03=3, date=0x31=31, month=0x12=12, year=0x24=24 -> year+2000=2024

test_stimuli.name: zero_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: seconds=0x00=0, minutes=0x00=0, hours=0x00=0, day=0x01=1, date=0x01=1, month=0x01=1, year=0x00=0 -> year+2000=2000
